mapper.select: SELECT event.preview_key, COALESCE(MIN(NULLIF(event.source_url, '')), '') AS source_url, link.canonical_url, COALESCE(event.provider_id, link.provider_id) AS provider_id, link.title, COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count, MIN(event.occurred_at) AS first_occurred_at, MAX(event.ai_requested) AS ai_requested, MAX(event.ai_succeeded) AS ai_succeeded FROM stats_event event JOIN stats_link link ON link.preview_key = event.preview_key WHERE event.event_type = 'PREVIEW_CREATED' AND event.occurred_at >= #{windowStart} AND event.occurred_at < #{windowEnd} AND link.title IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(link.title) != '' GROUP BY event.preview_key, link.canonical_url, link.title ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC, first_occurred_at ASC
